rootCause: isPublicAddress rejected every 192.0.x.x address as reserved instead of the IANA special-purpose 192.0.0.0/24. This incorrectly rejected NASA's public 192.0.66.108 DNS answer before safeFetch could read its RSS.
changes: Narrow the IPv4 protocol-assignment denial to 192.0.0.0/24, with globally reachable IANA exceptions 192.0.0.9 and 192.0.0.10.
Preserve a separate explicit denial for documentation range 192.0.2.0/24, all other IPv4 restrictions, and the existing IPv6 classifier.
Add deterministic regression coverage of NASA validation and the production fetchSource/safeFetch RSS path with injected DNS and a synthetic HTTP stream.
Verify DNS pinning, mixed public/private DNS rejection, private and special range boundaries, credentials, port restrictions, HTTPS, unsafe redirects, redirect limits and sensitive header stripping.
Record a controlled real NASA RSS read and an independently documented test-fixture DNS counter incident.

verification.before: Original classifier: NASA RSS URL validation rejected DNS address 192.0.66.108 with the private/reserved-address error. The final corrected test fixture reproduced 25 failures and 5 passes in an isolated temporary copy containing the original classifier; the production fetchSource/safeFetch RSS path also failed.
verification.after: Fixed classifier: 30 tests passed, zero failed. The public NASA IPv4 result is accepted, a synthetic NASA RSS yields one parsed entry through production fetchSource/safeFetch, and DNS pinning and all tested security restrictions remain enforced.

verification.before: Existing nearby tests were preserved unchanged.
verification.after: 33 tests passed, zero failed, including existing SSRF denials and public discovery/extraction workflows.

verification.command: safeFetch('https://www.nasa.gov/feed/', { requireHttps: true, timeout: 12000, maxBytes: 1048576 }); parseFeed(body, source)
verification.before: The adversarial report observed this NASA feed rejected locally as private/reserved despite a public HTTP 200 response.
verification.after: Real public read at 2026-10-18T04:56:40.420Z: HTTP 200; DNS resolved once to 192.0.66.108 and 2a04:fa87:fffd::c000:426c; 297386 bytes; application/rss+xml; 10 parsed RSS entries. No paid providers or credentials.

limitations: Deterministic regression tests inject DNS and a synthetic HTTP response stream; they execute production URL validation, pinning, redirects and RSS parsing without depending on Internet availability.
The separate real NASA read is a single current observation and does not guarantee future site availability.
No browser or global build was run. Final combined integration and UI verification belong to the coordinator.

The first post-fix test run had a DNS mock counter error (29 passed, 1 failed). The fixture was corrected, its final version was rechecked against the original classifier in an isolated temporary copy, and the incident was retained as evidence.
